title: 第5章 谢谢第6章 类型 人面两脚羊
slug: 无敌的女厉鬼有点恋爱脑
lines: “风凉，把羊皮袄穿上，别一会儿着了凉。”
陆远回到自己的地盘，瞧着枯树下那两个脱了袄子，浑身还冒着热气的师弟，眉梢轻挑。
刚才一人一大海碗的羊汤下肚，确实驱散了夜里的寒意，喝得人五内俱焚。
两个师弟向来听话，闻言便立刻将羊皮袄重新穿好。
陆远从兜里摸出一枚老旧的黄铜怀表，借着月光瞥了一眼。
夜里七点。
距离子时，还剩三个小时。
“时候不早了，最后检查一遍法事，顺便请老乡们吃顿‘晚饭’。”
陆远说着，迈步走向旁边一口沉甸甸的大箱子。
许二小和王成安立刻跟上，三人点燃一支蜡烛，幽微的火光映照出三张严肃的脸。
陆远取出一大把香，在烛火上引燃，猩红的火点在夜色中明灭。
“分开走，老规矩。”
三人随即分开，各自拿着一把香，走向这片山头的不同方向，开始给散落的坟头逐个上香。
许二小走向最远处，他手捧着香，脚步很轻，嘴里则低声念叨着：
“各位四方邻里，路过宝地，叨扰了。
有家的归家，有庙的归庙，无家无庙的，且顺着光亮往前走，莫在此地受凄凉。
拿了香火，便是缘分，各自安息，自有福报……”
王成安则走向另一侧，一边走，一边用更专业的调子念诵：
“清香通法界，供养无主灵。
太上敕令，超汝孤魂。
香云浮盖，径通幽冥。
受此香供，各宜安宁。”
陆远则负责就近的坟头，他动作不快，每到一处，都恭恭敬敬地插上三根香，口中祝祷：
“十方孤魂，过往神灵，今日途径，敬奉香火。
一盏清香，普同供养，勿扰阳间，各得安宁。”
今儿一天下来，这里的“老乡”们，给他的感觉都还不错。
都很安分。
只要供奉给到位，它们就承诺不捣乱。
如何承诺？
吃了香，就是承诺。
鬼物比人简单，尤其是这些道行不深，灵智未开的孤魂野鬼，它们不懂那么多弯弯绕绕。
受了香火，便等于立下了约定。
若有心怀不轨，想在夜里调皮捣蛋的，是绝不会碰这香火的。
一天下来，所有坟头的香火都被“吃”得干干净净，说明老乡们都很给面子。
这附近的孤魂野鬼其实不少，只是【斩妖除魔】系统并未一一标识。
那系统只会对能威胁到陆远安全，才会给出醒目的标识。
其他的，全凭陆远自己这一身道士的“把式”来感知。
他插着香，脚步一顿，来到一个颇为特殊的坟头前。
content_en:
"The wind is cold, so put on your sheepskin coat so you don't catch a cold."
Lu Yuan returned to his own territory and raised his eyebrows slightly as he looked at the two junior brothers who had taken off their coats and were still steaming under the dead tree.
The big bowl of mutton soup that each person had eaten just now really dispelled the chill of the night and made everyone burn inside and out.
The two junior brothers were always obedient, and upon hearing this, they immediately put on their sheepskin coats again.
Lu Yuan took out an old brass pocket watch from his pocket and glanced at it in the moonlight.
Seven o'clock at night.
There are three hours left until midnight.
"It's getting late. Let's check the rituals one last time and treat the fellow villagers to a 'dinner' by the way."
Lu Yuan said, walking towards a heavy box next to him.
Xu Erxiao and Wang Chengan immediately followed. The three of them lit a candle, and the faint firelight reflected three serious faces.
Lu Yuan took out a large handful of incense and lit it on the candle. The scarlet flames flickered in the night.
"Go separately, the old rule."
The three of them immediately separated, each holding a handful of incense, walking towards different directions on the hilltop, and began to add incense to the scattered graves one by one.
Xu Erxiao walked to the farthest point, holding the incense in his hand, walking very lightly, and murmuring in a low voice:
“Dear neighbors from all over the world, I’m passing by this treasure land and I’m sorry to bother you.
Those who have a home should return home, those who have a temple should return to the temple, and those who have no home or temple should move forward along the light, and do not suffer desolation here.
Take the incense, it is fate, rest in peace and have your own blessings..."
Wang Chengan walked to the other side, chanting in a more professional tone as he walked:
“The fragrance spreads through the Dharma Realm and makes offerings to the ownerless spirits.
Your Majesty’s decree transcends your lonely soul.
Fragrant clouds float on the cover, and the path leads to the netherworld.
Everyone should be at peace after receiving this incense offering. "
Lu Yuan was in charge of the nearby graves. He moved slowly. Everywhere he went, he respectfully put three sticks of incense and prayed:
“The lonely souls of the ten directions, the gods of the past, are passing by today to worship with incense.
A cup of fragrance, a universal offering, don’t disturb the world of the sun, everyone can find peace. "
At the end of the day today, the "fellows" here gave him a pretty good feeling.
They are all peaceful.
As long as the offerings are in place, they promise not to cause trouble.
How to commit?
It's a promise.
Ghosts are simpler than people, especially these lonely ghosts who are not deep in spiritual practice and have not yet developed their spiritual wisdom. They do not understand so many twists and turns.
Accepting the incense is equivalent to making a promise.
Anyone with evil intentions who wants to cause mischief at night will never touch this incense.
At the end of the day, the incense on all the graves was "eaten", which shows that the fellow villagers are very considerate.
There are actually quite a few lonely ghosts around here, but the [Demon Slayer] system has not identified them one by one.
The system will only give eye-catching signs to those who threaten Lu Yuan's safety.
The rest can only be perceived by Lu Yuan's own Taoist priest's "hands-on style".
He put incense, paused, and came to a rather special grave.
